- Color Grade: Imperial Vivid Green

- Chain Style: High-polish diamond-cut cable chain with a secure clasp.

Digital Torque Wrench SN-2340CN
body_html:
1、 Product positioning and core values
SN-2340CN is a high-precision digital torque control tool designed for scenarios that require strict control of bolt/nut tightening torque (such as automotive, mechanical, aviation, etc.). Through real-time digital display, intelligent alarm, data tracing and other functions, it solves the pain points of traditional wrenches such as "torque ambiguity and large errors", ensuring assembly quality and safety.
2、 Basic parameters
Project Details
Model SN-2340CN
Weight 2.628kg (balancing durability and portability)
Dimensions: 74 × 14 × 7.5cm (total length suitable for regular operations, compact structure)
3、 Structural analysis (combined with graphic design)

Schematic diagram of digital torque wrench structure
image

Head system:
Double sided ratchet head+ratchet torque square head: compatible with dual specifications, covering more types of bolts, easy to switch.
Central functional area:
Direction paddles: One click switch for forward/reverse, suitable for different fastening direction requirements.
Large LCD screen: high-definition display of torque values, units, and working modes, still clear in low light environments.
Communication port: Supports torque data export (such as connecting to a computer/mobile phone) for quality analysis and traceability.
Buzzer: Automatically sounds when the set torque is reached to avoid human error.
Operation buttons (C/U/V, etc.): Implement functions such as mode switching, unit conversion, data storage/clearing, etc.
Tail and handle:
Battery cover: easy to disassemble and replace, ensuring continuous operation.
Anti slip handle: Ergonomic design, comfortable grip, reduces fatigue from prolonged operation.
4、 Core functional highlights
Precise torque control:
The accuracy reaches ± 1% (within full range), ensuring that every tightening meets the standard and avoiding "over tightening fracture, under tightening loosening".
Multi mode adaptation:
Tracking mode: Real time display of applied torque, dynamic monitoring of tightening process.
Peak mode: Record the maximum torque during tightening for easy review afterwards.
Preset mode: Set the target torque, sound and light dual alarms (beep+screen display) when reaching the standard, and force standardized operation.
Flexible switching of units:
Supports units such as N · m, ft · lb, kgf · cm, covering metric and imperial standards, and adapting to the needs of different industries.
Data management:
Built in storage chip, capable of recording multiple sets of torque data; Combining communication functions to achieve data export and information management, adapting to the quality traceability system of modern production lines.
Durability guarantee:
The main body is made of chrome vanadium steel material, which is impact resistant, corrosion-resistant, and stable and reliable in dealing with complex working conditions such as oil pollution and vibration.
5、 Typical application scenarios
In the automotive field, torque calibration of tire bolts, engine components, and chassis screws meets original factory standards.
Mechanical assembly: Precision assembly of industrial equipment and machine tools to ensure the stability of equipment operation.
Aerospace: critical links such as cabin connection and pipeline fixation require strict torque control for safety.
Home appliance manufacturing: Assembly of core components such as motors and compressors to enhance product lifespan and reliability.

body_html:
Premium Material: 
Made of food-grade polypropylene, this sediment filter is tested against NSF/ANSI 42 standards and delivers high standards of safety. Its melt-blown construction ensures no fiber shedding, giving you a reliable and clean water filtration solution. 

MultiI-Layer Structure:
Engineered with three distinct density layers, this melt‑blown cartridge captures particles throughout its entire depth—not just on the surface. Unlike standard single‑layer filters, this design holds more sediment, extends filter life, and keeps water flowing steadily. 

Superior Performance: 
This water filter effortlessly intercepts up to 99% sediment, including rust, sand, dirt and sludge. As the first-stage filter in the whole house filtration system, it protects your post-filters, appliances, pipes, faucets, and shower heads from clogging, providing cleaner and fresher water for your home.

High Dirt-loading Capacity:
The water filter cartridge can last up to 15,000-20,000 gallons of water, depending on the quality of your inlet water and household usage. For optimal performance, we recommend replacing the filter at least every 6 months.

Standard Universal Fit:
10 x 4.5-inch universal filter cartridge size, fits most 10-inch BB filter housings (13.3"x7.3"). Used as a prefilter for reverse osmosis (RO) and whole house water filtration systems, and various commercial and industrial applications.
